Toyota.quote: Every Toyota vehicle is supported by a 36-month/60,000 km limited warranty coverage. ... 36 MONTHS / 60,000 km* Basic | 60 Months / 100,000 km* Powertrain Warranty (*Whichever comes first)
Toyota.notes: BEV components and EV battery 8 yr / 160,000 km. Lexus is a separate make, not covered here.

Ford.quote: Bumper-to-Bumper Coverage: 3 years/60,000 kilometres ... Powertrain Coverage: 5 years/100,000 kilometres
Ford.notes: Cross-checked against Ford of Canada 2025 MY Warranty Guide (Ford cars and trucks except F-650/750) on fordservicecontent.com. Diesel unique powertrain 5 yr / 160,000 km. Hybrid/EV unique components 8 yr / 160,000 km. Some fleet trucks get 5 yr / 160,000 km powertrain.

Honda.quote: Power Train Warranty | Five years or 100,000 Km, whichever occurs first. ... Distributor's Warranty | Three Years or 60,000 Km, whichever occurs first.
Honda.notes: Honda calls basic coverage the Distributor's Warranty; both measured from the warranty registration date. Honda's '5 Year/100,000 km' marketing is the powertrain term, not comprehensive. Hybrid system 8 yr / 160,000 km. Acura is a separate make.

Hyundai.quote: Hyundai Canada offers New Vehicle Limited Warranty coverage for 5 years or 100,000 km. Hyundai's Powertrain Warranty covers the engine and transaxle for 5 years or 100,000 km, whichever occurs first.
Hyundai.notes: Transfers to later owners at no charge. Hybrid, PHEV and EV systems 8 yr / 160,000 km.

Chevrolet.quote: The Base Warranty coverage for Chevrolet, Buick, and GMC is for 3 years or 60,000 kilometres, whichever comes first ... Gasoline and Diesel powertrain components are covered for 5 years or 100,000 kilometres, whichever comes first.
Chevrolet.notes: 2026 MY booklet. TurboMax and 3.0L/6.6L Duramax: 5 yr / 160,000 km powertrain. EVs have no powertrain row; propulsion battery 8 yr / 160,000 km.

GMC.quote: The Base Warranty coverage for Chevrolet, Buick, and GMC is for 3 years or 60,000 kilometres, whichever comes first ... Gasoline and Diesel powertrain components are covered for 5 years or 100,000 kilometres, whichever comes first.
GMC.notes: 2025 MY booklet linked from gmccanada.ca; 2026 GM Canada booklet has identical wording. TurboMax and Duramax: 5 yr / 160,000 km powertrain. EVs: no powertrain row; battery 8 yr / 160,000 km.

Kia.quote: 5-year/100,000 km - Worry-free comprehensive warranty covering virtually the entire vehicle. 5-year/100,000 km - Powertrain Warranty covering the engine, transmission, axles, differentials and driveshafts.
Kia.notes: Hybrid, PHEV and EV components 8 yr / 150,000 km; high-voltage battery 8 yr / 160,000 km.

Nissan.quote: The duration of POWERTRAIN Warranty is 60 months or 100,000 kilometres (whichever comes first). ... 36 months/60,000 kilometres Basic Warranty
Nissan.notes: 2025 MY all-models booklet; 2024 booklet matches. A nissan.ca FAQ says 36 months/50,000 km but looks stale. GT-R and LEAF have their own booklets, not checked.

Mazda.quote: The New Vehicle Limited Warranty period is 36 months (unlimited distance). ... Basic 36 Unlimited Distance ... Powertrain 60 Unlimited Distance
Mazda.notes: km null means unlimited distance. Commercial-use or exported vehicles fall back to Basic 36 months / 80,000 km and Powertrain 60 months / 100,000 km. Standard on 2015 and later.

Ram.quote: Basic Warranty coverage is for 3 years or 60,000 kilometres (Whichever comes first. Some conditions may apply). ... a 5-year or 100,000-kilometre fully transferable Powertrain Limited Warranty (Whichever comes first. Some conditions may apply)
Ram.notes: 2026 Ram 1500/2500/3500/Chassis Cab/ProMaster bought retail: 10 yr / 160,000 km powertrain, not transferable (except QC, NS, SK) and not for fleet; this row keeps the transferable 5/100 because resale is what matters here. Cummins diesel 5 yr / 160,000 km. SRT 3 yr / 60,000 km powertrain.

Jeep.quote: Basic Warranty coverage is for 3 years or 60,000 kilometres (Whichever comes first. Some conditions may apply). ... Most 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 and 2027 Chrysler, Jeep, Dodge, Ram and FIAT vehicles are backed by a 5-year or 100,000-kilometre fully transferable Powertrain Limited Warranty
Jeep.notes: Model years 2022 to 2027 ('most'). 4xe hybrid battery 8 yr / 160,000 km. SRT 3 yr / 60,000 km powertrain.

Subaru.quote: Subaru New Vehicle Limited Warranty (36-month / 60,000-km) ... Subaru Major Component Warranty (60-month / 100,000-km) When the Subaru New Vehicle Limited Warranty expires, major components will continue to be covered up to a total of 60 months from the date of initial registration or 100,000 km, whichever comes first.
Subaru.notes: Subaru calls powertrain the Major Component Warranty. Transfers to later owners who register with Subaru Canada. EV battery and drive unit 8 yr / 160,000 km.

Volkswagen.quote: New-vehicle warranty for 2018–2026 models 4-year / 80,000 km New Vehicle Limited Warranty ... Powertrain 5-year / 100,000 km Powertrain Limited Warranty
Volkswagen.notes: Model years 2018 to 2026; 2017 and older: owner's manual. Wear items covered first 12 months / 20,000 km only. ID. Buzz high-voltage system 8 yr / 160,000 km.

BMW.quote: The warranty period is up to 4 years or 80,000 kilometres, whichever occurs first, and begins on the date of first retail sale, or the date the vehicle is placed in service as a demonstrator or company vehicle, whichever is earlier.
BMW.notes: No separate powertrain warranty; the powertrain is under the 4 yr / 80,000 km New Vehicle Limited Warranty, so both rows match. Latest-generation EV high-voltage battery 8 yr / 160,000 km.

Mitsubishi.quote: 5-YEAR/100,000 KM NEW VEHICLE LIMITED WARRANTY ... 10-YEAR/160,000 KM POWERTRAIN LIMITED WARRANTY ... In Canada, the warranty follows the vehicle and does not need to be transferred.
Mitsubishi.notes: Page is client-rendered; read in a real browser. Warranty follows the vehicle to later owners in Canada. Lithium-ion battery 10 yr / 160,000 km.
